meta.name: golden-chat-single
meta.description: Use when testing the golden_chat_single golden build

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要验证黄金构建的聊天功能
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to verify the golden chat build

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以读取 golden-chat-single 的 Slack 聊天记录，回答其中讨论过的问题、引用代码片段、解释团队决策、提供故障排查步骤或分享链接资源。
howto.when: 当你询问 golden-chat-single 聊天历史中曾讨论过的解决方案、代码、决策或资源时触发。

say.text: 帮我找到 golden-chat-single 聊天中分享的链接。
say.note: Claude 会列出聊天中分享的链接。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can read the golden-chat-single Slack chat history to answer questions about solutions, code snippets, team decisions, troubleshooting steps, or shared links discussed in that chat.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about solutions, code, decisions, or resources that were discussed in the golden-chat-single chat history.

say_en.text: What is the solution discussed in golden-chat-single chat for this issue?
say_en.note: Claude will search the chat history for the answer.

say_en.text: Find the links shared in golden-chat-single chat.
say_en.note: Claude will list the links from the chat.
